description: A shotgunner that sees the player follows them down the 18-unit step lane, climbs the step, and closes in until one more think's worth of movement would reach them, then stops.

expect.note: It saw the player (128 units ahead) on its first think and follows them east at its run speed of 110, still on the lane floor before the step at x = 256.
It has climbed the 18-unit step: standing 18 + 24 + 1/32 above the lane floor.

The player stopped on the step near x = 495. The enemy stops when one more think's worth of movement (11 units, plus Quake's 1-unit growth on each box) would reach the player's box, about 42 units between origins.
